title: platostoma strictum
intro: Platostoma strictum, commonly known as African Blue Sage or African Basil, is a medicinal plant native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Platostoma strictum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to act as an expectorant, to reduce fever, and to soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Platostoma strictum include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
